title: Add one inventory product and remove it from the cart
steps: Record the name and price of Sauce Labs Backpack on the inventory page.
Click Add to Cart for Sauce Labs Backpack.
Compare the cart item name and price with the recorded inventory values.
Remove the product from the cart.
expected_result: The cart badge increases to 1 after adding; the selected product appears with the same name and price; after removal the cart badge is no longer shown or is 0 and the cart is empty.

title: Cart remains unchanged when no product is added
steps: Do not click Add to Cart for any product.
expected_result: No cart badge is displayed or its count remains 0, and the cart contains no product.

title: Add two different products and verify independent cart entries
steps: Record the names and prices of Sauce Labs Backpack and Bike Light.
Add both products to the cart.
Compare both item names and prices with the inventory values.
Remove one product and observe the cart badge and remaining item.
expected_result: The cart badge reaches 2; both products appear with matching names and prices; removing one product reduces the badge to 1 and leaves the other product intact.
